title: SS27 Boys' Workwear Denim
summary: Denim leads boyswear: carpenter shorts, chore jackets, overalls and coordinated denim sets, washed light and mid blue.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Denim's "presence felt stronger and more diverse than in recent seasons" at Playtime Paris, across everyday, workwear-inspired and coordinated styles <sup>[1]</sup>. Dungarees and lightweight jackets are on Fatamadrina's SS27 silhouette list <sup>[2]</sup>. Most SS27 kidswear sources describe collections across ages and genders. The evidence below is the fair record; the shapes, products and sizes are Forecut's application of it to boyswear, roughly ages 4 to 14.

sections.heading: Colours
sections.body: Light and mid indigo with sand, red and white.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Carpenter and relaxed denim shorts.
- Chore jacket and overshirt.
- Short overalls.
- Denim shirt and short set.

sections.heading: Fabrics
sections.body:
- Lightweight cotton denim and chambray.
- Twill for workwear shorts.
- Recycled or organic cotton denim where certified <sup>[3]</sup>.

sections.heading: Trims and details
sections.body:
- Hammer loops and patch pockets (bar-tacked, no sharp edges).
- Corozo or metal shank buttons, pull-tested.
- Contrast topstitching.

timing: In stores February to July 2027; carries into autumn.
products: - Denim shorts, chore jackets, overalls, denim shirts.
design_implications:
- Adjustable waists for growth.
- Pre-wash to control shrinkage; check abrasion on knees and seat.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Denim is a volume category for boys; keep the wash palette tight.
